description: Representative Meerkat CRM database for the source import (issue #353). Exercises every mapped concept plus the pathological shapes from TEST-02 (issue #430) that a Meerkat deployment can express: multi-valued fields, custom fields, reciprocal and dangling relationships, Unicode, very long values, year-unknown birthdays, soft-deleted rows, and a second source user the importer must not silently mix in. The loader (backend/internal/meerkatfixture) builds a real Meerkat-schema SQLite file from this manifest; the meerkat.Open reader and MapMeerkatSnapshot consume it exactly like a production deployment's file.
